Class TowerInfoPanel

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.VBox
gui.ingame.TowerInfoPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class TowerInfoPanel extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
A JavaFX UI component that displays detailed information and interaction options for a selected tower in the game.

This panel allows the player to view the tower's stats (like damage dealt), change its targeting mode, purchase upgrades along two distinct paths, and sell the tower. It relies on live refresh methods to keep the UI in sync with the underlying game state.
